content.short: Lombard issues LBTC, yield-bearing Bitcoin used across DeFi as collateral and for trading.
content.description: Lombard is on-chain Bitcoin infrastructure best known for LBTC, a yield-bearing Bitcoin token. It reports more than $3 billion of BTC onboarded and over 270,000 holders, who use LBTC for yield, as collateral and in trading. Stable's official ecosystem page lists Lombard, and CoinGecko includes LBTC in its Stable ecosystem.
content.meta: Lombard issues LBTC, yield-bearing Bitcoin for DeFi, listed in Stable's official ecosystem.
